war_input_divergence.pinned_off: F-DEF, the fitted defensive and positional column
war_input_divergence.why: F-DEF wins the WAR projection gate and loses the money gate. Dropping it from pricing only takes AAV error from 3.135 to 2.909 (about 2.5 times the smallest difference this test can resolve) and widens the model's edge over its baseline from 0.224 to 0.340. It also improves the guarantee and the mega-deal error.
war_input_divergence.consequence: Free agent prices on this page are built on a WAR projection that excludes defense. The MLB Projections module includes it, so the two can show different WAR for the same player. Both are doing the job they were measured for.
